action_items: No API-bearing acceptance criteria this iteration; Phase 2 3D lab is entirely client-side (procedural Three.js, mocked local Explain response, no auth) so no backend test files were added.

checks.criterion: Textbook Explore flow opens the live 3D lab
checks.name: textbook-explore-opens-lab
checks.evidence: Module 02 Explore tab showed Open full 3D lab button; click navigated to /lab and rendered a canvas inside three-canvas-host.

checks.criterion: HDFS model visualizes the required architecture
checks.name: hdfs-default-scene-architecture
checks.evidence: Default /lab loaded HDFS mode active, title HDFS Architecture, overlay confirmed 4 DataNodes · 6 blocks · 2× replication, canvas rendered with visible size (no external model download).

checks.name: camera-orbit-zoom-reset
checks.evidence: Canvas pixel diff confirmed change after mouse drag (orbit) and wheel scroll (zoom); Reset camera button clicked successfully afterward.

checks.name: raycaster-object-selection
checks.evidence: Clicking canvas populated selected-object-name/type/description/properties; Explain this button revealed explain-this-response with mocked local text.

checks.name: animation-pause-play-reset
checks.evidence: Toggle button switched between 'Pause flow' and 'Play flow' labels; Reset animation button returned flow to paused/initial state.

checks.criterion: Dynamic HDFS parameters update model and numericals
checks.name: dynamic-hdfs-parameters-update-metrics
checks.evidence: DataNodes/blocks/replication sliders updated canvas overlay text (6 DataNodes, 10 blocks, 3× replication) and metrics-list content changed accordingly.

checks.criterion: Topic visual modes cover all five syllabus modules
checks.name: topic-visual-modes-switch-scenes
checks.evidence: Cycled foundations, mongodb, hive-pig, spark-web, hdfs; each activated its mode button, updated lab-current-mode-title, and produced a distinct canvas pixel screenshot.

checks.criterion: Scene visibility and responsive behavior work
checks.name: scene-visibility-and-responsive
checks.evidence: Labels/connections/blocks toggle buttons switched ON/OFF states; resized to 834x1112 tablet viewport kept canvas (>50px) and inspector visible with zero failed network requests.
